_schema: CardDefId -> {type: vanilla(无能力)|on_reveal|ongoing|special, cost, power（基础值，实战观测）, ability, tags}。当前覆盖「入门卡组」12 张，可扩展。

Hawkeye.ability: On Reveal: If you play a card here next turn, +3 Power.

Medusa.ability: On Reveal: If this is at the middle location, +3 Power.

Starlord.ability: On Reveal: If your opponent played a card here this turn, +3 Power.

Sentinel.ability: On Reveal: Add another Sentinel to your hand.

Punisher.ability: Ongoing: +1 Power for each opposing card at this location.

Gamora.ability: On Reveal: If your opponent played a card here this turn, +5 Power.

IronMan.ability: Ongoing: Your total Power is doubled at this location.

SpiderMan.ability: On Reveal: Move to another location and pull an enemy card from here to there. Activate: Repeat the On Reveal ability.
SpiderMan.notes: 国服文本（用户截图 2026-11-07）：揭示与激活都会把自己移到另外两路之一并拉一张敌牌过去，结果随机
